statement: For one frozen release-content digest, three consecutive fresh-container five-node runs complete cold formation, user-table creation and readiness, and initial runtime-service placement without a formation, table, placement, or safety stall.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
All three terminal reports must boot the exact frozen release candidate and name its release-content and source fingerprints; any content drift resets the streak.
Each counted PASS starts from fresh containers and independently covers cold five-node formation, user-table creation and readiness, and initial runtime-service placement through production owners.
Do not use the distributed streak as an iteration loop. Prove every intervention through a deterministic real-owner regression before another certification run.
Closure certifies the named release scenario only; it does not establish a general bounded-latency or pass-rate promise.
